description: Source code for DNS hosts file parsing and management in the Chromium project, including classes for parsing hosts files, handling host entries, and reading host files from disk.

classes.name: HostsParser
classes.description: Parses the contents of a hosts file, tokenizing IP addresses and hostnames.

classes.name: DnsHostsFileParser
classes.description: Handles reading and parsing the hosts file from disk into DNS host mappings.

methods.name: ParseHostsWithCommaMode
methods.description: Parses the contents of a hosts file string into DNS hosts map with specified comma mode.

methods.name: DnsHostsFileParser::ParseHosts
methods.description: Reads the hosts file from disk and parses its contents into DNS hosts map.
